sloka: धर्मात्मा स शुभै: कृत्स्नै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणैः ।धूतपापो गत: स्वर्गं पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥ २.१०५.३२॥
transliteration: dharmātmā sa śubhai: kṛtsnai: kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।dhūtapāpo gata: svargaṁ pitā na: pṛthivīpati: ॥ 2.105.32॥

translations.english: Our righteous father and lord of the earth, Dasaratha, attained heaven by giving abundant charities and performing several sacrifices in accordance with tradition.
